answer: Just to flag it, all four of those moves were during 2025 rather than this year, but here's the run: you started on Kestrel Mutual (there since you bought the Civic), and in January the premium jumped about $40/month with no warning, so in May you moved to Bluepine and saved roughly $300 a year.
